mechanism: Propylthiouracil may increase fluticasone metabolism via CYP3A4 induction during hyperthyroid states, potentially reducing corticosteroid efficacy, while fluticasone's immunosuppression may mask symptoms of agranulocytosis from propylthiouracil.
action: Monitor clinical response to fluticasone therapy and consider dose adjustment; obtain baseline and periodic CBC to detect propylthiouracil-related agranulocytosis, as corticosteroid immunosuppression may delay symptom recognition.
